text: 欢迎来到新加坡Hello children, nice to see you, 我是来自松江区新桥小学的平老师,you can call me Ms.Ping.Let's begin our class.Please get your student's book and workbook ready.First, let's learn the sounds.Please read after me.smokesmokesmokesm are pronounced as sm.spiderHere, sp are pronounced as sp.starHere, st are pronounced as st.Now, let's listen and follow.spspiderststarsmsmokespspiderststarSpider, spider, what can you see?I can see a small star on the tree.Spider, spider, what can you see?I can see some sticks and some smoke in front of me.Look, she is Kitty.Kitty wants to buy some food.What food does Kitty want to buy?Maybe she wants a bottle of water.Maybe she wants chocolate or biscuits.What food does she want?Let's listen and choose.I want a loaf of bread.I want a bowl of chocolate.I want a packet of biscuits and a bowl of noodles.Kitty wants a loaf of bread,a bar of chocolate,a packet of biscuits and a bowl of noodles.Please listen and follow.a loaf of breada loaf of breada loaf of breada bar of chocolatea bar of chocolatea bar of chocolatea packet of biscuitsa packet of biscuitsa packet of biscuitsa bowl of noodlesa bowl of noodlesa bowl of noodlesWhat food does Kitty want?She wants a loaf of bread.She wants a bar of chocolate.She wants a packet of biscuits.She wants a bowl of noodles.Please read after me again.Please read it by yourself.Now let's read together.Kitty wants to buy the food.Now she is on her way.She sees a pet shop on the way.Let's listen and enjoy.How much is that doggy in the window?The doggy will have every tail.I do not like that doggy for sale.Now she comes to the shop.Look!A packet of biscuits.A bottle of water.A bar of chocolate.A bowl of noodles.A packet of sweets.A loaf of bread.So much food in the shop.Do you remember?And a bowl of noodles.Look at the loaf of bread.How much is it?Good.It's eight yuan.Read after me.It's six yuan.Now, can you ask?Very good.It's ten yuan.Let's read together.The packet of biscuits is ten yuan.She also wants a bowl of noodles.Can you ask and answer?It's five yuan.The bowl of noodles is five yuan.Look, Chorin.Kitty is in the shop.There is much food in the shop.How much are they?It's twenty-nine yuan together.They are twenty-nine yuan together.Again.Now please read after me.She wants a packet of biscuits and a bowl of noodles.And the bowl of noodles is five yuan.This time please think and say.It's 8 yuan.She wants a bowl of chocolate.The packet of biscuits is 10 yuan.She also wants a box of chocolate.She wants a box of biscuits and a bowl of noodles.The packet of biscuits is 10 yuan, and the bowl of noodles is 5 yuan.They are 29 yuan together.Nice reading.Alice and Tom also want to buy some food.What do they want to buy?How much?Please take out your workbook.Turn to page 59.Take out your pencil and the ruler.Let's do part B, listen and match.Are you ready?Listen and match.听录音,把食品和相应的价格连起来。A bowl of noodles, please.9 yuan.How much are two bars of chocolate?They are 16 yuan.Let's check the answers.How much is a loaf of bread?Yes, it's 8 yuan.How much are two bottles of water?Good, they are 6 yuan.How much is a small packet of sweets?How much is a bowl of noodles?Very good, they are 16 yuan.Have you got the right answers?Well done for today's assignments.Look and read.Student's book, page 42.Look and learn.Finish the exercise on page 59 of your workbook, part A, listen and circle.So much for today.Goodbye, children.
